public class ReadExcel {

	XSSFWorkbook workbook;
	XSSFSheet sheet;
	XSSFRow row; 
	XSSFCell cell; 
	FileInputStream input;
	
	
	public ReadExcel() {
		
		try {
			input=new FileInputStream(".//src/test/java/comutilities/Data.xlsx");
			workbook=new XSSFWorkbook(input);
			sheet=workbook.getSheetAt(0);
		} catch (Exception e) {
			// TODO Auto-generated catch block
			e.printStackTrace();
		}
	}
	
	public int getRowcount() {
		return sheet.getLastRowNum(); 
	}
	public int getCellcount() {
		return sheet.getRow(0).getLastCellNum(); 
	}
	
	public String readData(int rowNum, int cellNum) {
		row=sheet.getRow(rowNum);
		cell=row.getCell(cellNum);
		
		String data="";
		try {
			DataFormatter format=new DataFormatter();
			data=format.formatCellValue(cell);
		}catch(Exception e) {
			return data; 
		}
		
		try {
			workbook.close();
			input.close();
		} catch (IOException e) {
			// TODO Auto-generated catch block
			e.printStackTrace();
		}
		
		return data; 
		
		
	}
	
	
	
}




public class DefineLoginDDT {
	
		ReadExcel readex;
		
		@DataProvider(name="UserData")
		public String[][] userData(){
			readex=new ReadExcel(); 
			 
			int rowCount=readex.getRowcount();
			int cellCount=readex.getCellcount(); 
			String data[][]=new String[rowCount-1][cellCount];
			for(int i=1;i<rowCount;i++ ) {
				for(int j=0;j<cellCount;j++) {
					data[i-1][j]=readex.readData(i, j);
				}
			}
			
			return data;
		}
}


@Test(dataProvider = "UserData" , dataProviderClass = DefineLoginDDT.class)
	void multiLogin(String username, String userpass) {
		lp=new LoginPage(driver); 
		readProp=new ReadProperty();
		
		driver.get(readProp.getUrl());
		Assert.assertEquals(driver.getTitle(), readProp.getLoginPageTitle());
		logger.info("Login page validated");
		
		lp.setUserName(username);
		logger.info("Entered Username");
		lp.setUserPass(userpass);
		logger.info("Entered Userpass");
		lp.clickLogin();
		logger.info("Clicked to login button");
		if(lp.isUserIdPresent()) {
			System.out.println("User logged in");
			logger.info("User logged in");
		}else {
			lp.unSuccessFullMsg(); 
			logger.error("Loging unsuccessfull");
		}
		
	}

}
